title_tr: Yeniden açılan görev ilerleme raporunda hâlâ tamamlanmış sayılıyor
issue: After a DONE task is reopened, the project progress report still counts it as done, so the completion percentage is too high.

ground_truth.root_cause: ProjectReports.progress counts tasks with completed_at set as done, and TaskService.reopen no longer clears completed_at, so reopened tasks still look done.
